species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 22–38 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 22–38 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northeast wind at 21 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
